reconcile.note: The Geneva Bible annotators call this a synecdoche: the promise was certain and counted as Abraham's own though his descendants took physical possession long after his death.

sides.snippet: I will give to you, and to your seed after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession.
sides.verseText: I will give to you, and to your seed after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.\"

sides.snippet: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on.
sides.verseText: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when he still had no child.
